title: Exclude one exterior arrival as the sole restoration of six chart-283 exits
body:
All 17 optimistic price survivors fail the single-scalar restoration. Six original exterior rows plus the retained recoded x43 have rank seven, exceeding the six input scalars.

## Scope and source

Uses pinned #7924 and retains all six outgoing payloads. Separately reproduces the earlier #7923 archive source omission and its corrected source control. The owner roster and clock charges are explicit. The source comparator is #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; toolkit #7852 `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`. The included source manifest identifies every public dependency used.

## Reproduction

Extract `research/p104-bit388-six-exit-rank-cut/replay.tar.gz` into an empty directory, check its checksum manifest, and run the extracted commands. Full original 680-square replays, actual restoration consumers, a rank minor and exact x43⊕x74 separator passed the local cold checks. Hosted execution is separate.

## Open next questions

Allow changes to downstream readers or a different arrival roster, and charge every resulting restoration.

Clear1nsight prepared this result with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the predecessor authors identified in the archive. [Campaign board](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19789228).
